description: This course is designed to give level 2 students an introduction to research. The student will undertake a laboratory based investigation on a topic proposed by the supervisor. Students work independently but under the close supervision of the supervisor.
preclusion: If undertaking an Undergraduate Degree THEN ( must not have completed FST2288R at a grade of at least D)

prerequisite: If undertaking an Undergraduate Degree THEN ( must have completed 1 of FST1101/FST1101B at a grade of at least D)
prerequisiteRule: PROGRAM_TYPES IF_IN Undergraduate Degree THEN (COURSES (1) FST1101:D, FST1101B:D)
title: Basic UROPS in Food Science & Technology I
